description: Lab reference ranges: where a value sits (below, within with bounds included, above), one-sided ranges, text values and missing ranges; the owner's range over the typical one; an alias; the weekly summary's range and status
notes: Typical ranges from config/lab-ranges.json: Hemoglobin 13.5 to 17.5, HDL 40 or more (no upper bound), TSH Reflex 0.45 to 4.5 (alias TSH).
Hemoglobin 12.9 is below 13.5; 18 is above 17.5; 15 is within; 13.5 sits on the bound, so within.
HDL (one-sided): 38 is below 40; 55 is within (no upper bound).
A text value such as '<0.5' has no number: no status. A test with no range: no status.
The owner's range (13 to 17) replaces the typical one; an owner range with both bounds cleared means no range at all.
Summary: Hemoglobin drawn 2026-03-02 at 12.9 after 14.1 on 2025-09-01: change -1.2, range 13.5 to 17.5, below.
